entrypoints.cli: pe6203 adapt; pe6203 run --adaptation artifact.json (exclusive with --knowledge)
entrypoints.experiment: ./experiment: prepare freezes input/code hashes; run adapts and executes; report recomputes from five judge records

knowledge.coverage: complete catalog of fixed official task server set
knowledge.no_update: Keep entire Early K0, schema and routing; never refresh from live metadata
knowledge.serialization: Append usage_rules/output_schema to description; actual schema becomes model parameters
knowledge.namespaced_alias: sanitize name to [a-zA-Z0-9_-], first 50 chars + __ + first 12 SHA256(server_id::name); max 64; collisions rejected
knowledge.native_unique: Legacy policy; duplicates rejected, never drop tools
knowledge.selective_patch: Preserve unselected records canonical-equal including source version; envelope target version may differ from unchanged records

adaptation.runner_effect: Loads knowledge and update cost; saves copied artifact/hash/method
adaptation.no_update: Deep-copy Early; zero update cost; algorithm ignores target metadata; writer reads target for provenance
adaptation.full_rewrite: LLM rewrites all target tool descriptions; schemas/routes/rules fixed. Early reuses K0.
adaptation.failure: Persist validation errors; no silent fallback; costs retained

execution.tasks: Only official selected IDs with complete reviewed profiles
execution.inputs: Only question and method knowledge; no reference answers, historical scores or mutation labels
execution.fixture: Reject symlinks; copy sourced files into new workspace and hash
execution.containment: Private HOME/storage; workingDirectory fixed to run workspace; application-level, not OS sandbox
execution.provider_options: agent.extra_body and judge.extra_body forwarded; config records them

exit_codes.0: five valid judge results; not necessarily task success

execution.task223: Netlify/frozen-source runtime is explicit in config, separate variant; staged archived fetcher still executes against fixed local HTML replay. Source hint shared by all methods, original question unchanged.

artifacts.fixture-manifest.json: Source file hashes when fixture configured
artifacts.events.jsonl: Incremental responses, tool calls/results, judge results
artifacts.result.json: Statuses, nullable scores, usage, model/config/knowledge hashes

batch.identity: plan/config + Python source + benchmark/profile/uv lock + knowledge/fixture bytes + endpoints; no keys
batch.resume: Reject identity/result-hash changes; reuse existing result incl blocked/incomplete/low scores; interrupted without result gets at most one extra attempt
limits: cell uses explicit knowledge/cost, not automatic adaptation

hashes.object_digest: benchmark.digest JSON serialization; distinct from bytes
hashes.canonical_equal: object keys ignored; list order and text preserved
hashes.artifact_cost: Count once per server_group/target_stage/strategy/repeat_id; shared tasks do not double-count
